hese lessons are the essence of what military  doctrine teaches leaders today in regards to maneuver.   Maneuver is not as simple as following a few basic rules. The commander must  determine where and how he will maneuver his force into a position of advantage over the  enemy. The risk is not to place your own force in a position of disadvantage. Much of the journey was on  foot, through dense rainforests and swamps. The  governor of Panama had been forewarned of a  potential attack, and had sent Spanish troops to attack  Morgan and his men along the route.    The privateers transferred to canoes to complete part  of the journey, but were still able to beat off the  ambushes with ease.    After three days, with the river difficult to navigate in  places, and with the jungle thinning out, Morgan  landed his men and travelled overland across the  remaining part of the isthmus.
